info.name: RentCheck REST Account Settings Work Orders V2 API

params.name: page_number
params.description: The page number of the collection. Zero-indexed.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of elements in the data collection.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort results by one of the available fields.

params.name: sort_type
params.description:
Sort direction. Accepted case-insensitively — any casing
of `asc` / `desc` is silently normalised to `ASC` / `DESC`.

params.name: search
params.description: Search string to match in several work order's fields

params.name: property_id
params.description: Property ID to filter work orders by. Only work orders whose source inspection lives on this property are returned.

params.name: inspection_type[]
params.description:
List of inspection types to filter work orders. Repeat the parameter
to send multiple values (e.g. `?inspection_type[]=Move-In&inspection_type[]=Move-Out`).

params.name: status[]
params.description:
List of work order statuses to filter by. Repeat the parameter to
send multiple values. Allowed individual values are `Created`,
`In Progress`, `Completed`, and `Canceled`. The raw array is not
validated, so unknown values are silently ignored — they simply
return zero matches instead of a 400.

params.name: start_created_date
params.description: Value to filter work order creation date by a starting date

params.name: end_created_date
params.description: Value to filter work order creation date by an ending date
